newsitem.title: USA: Camco to buy Production Operators Corp.
newsitem.headline: Camco to buy Production Operators Corp.

text.p: Camco International Inc and Production Operators Corp said they have signed a definitive agreement under which Camco will acquire Production Operators in a deal valued at about $575 million.

Under the terms of the deal, which were approved by both companies boards, Production Operators shareholders will receive 1.30 newly issued Camco common shares for each Production Operators common share owned.
The companies said the exchange ratio is fixed and will not be adjusted for changes in the market price of either company's common stock.

The transaction is expected to be tax-free and accounted for as a pooling of interests. It is subject to approval by the shareholders of both companies, appropriate regulatory approvals and other customary conditions.
Closing of the transaction is expected to occur during the second quarter of 1997.
